h: The Third Meal and the Enduring Truth of Yaakov

p: Now the third meal of Shabbos
הוּא נֶגֶד יַעֲקֹב אָבִינוּ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם
corresponds to Yaakov Avinu, peace be upon him,
as is written in Pri Etz Chaim;
and as is written in the holy Zohar,
that "and I will feed you the heritage of Yaakov your father" (Yeshayahu 58:14)
is the meal of Zeir Anpin;
And this is the attribute of truth,
"The lip of truth shall be established forever."
For the attributes of love and fear,
which are the aspects of Avraham and Yitzchak,
and they pass and go away,
and there is not yet in this a clarification
and if it does not endure,
אֲבָל בְּחִינַת יַעֲקֹב אָבִינוּ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם
But the aspect of Yaakov Avinu, peace be upon him,
forever and ever and not cease;
and as it is said in the name of
הָרַבִּי רַבִּי בּוּנִם זֵכֶר צַדִּיק לִבְרָכָה
the Rebbe Reb Bunim, may the memory of the tzaddik be a blessing,
that Rivkah thought in her mind
that it was one fetus in her womb,
therefore "she went to inquire of Hashem,"
what would be the main thing in the end,
And on this it was said to her:
and the main one would be Yaakov,
through whom it will become clear
holiness will endure for his generations.
For all the souls of Yisrael
are called the House of Yaakov,
over all the individual souls of Yisrael,
in the end they will remain in holiness;
for "no one banished will remain banished from Him" (Shmuel II 14:14).
"Though I walk in the valley of the shadow of death,
from the Rebbe of Izbitza, may the memory of the tzaddik be a blessing,
of Hashem, may He be blessed.
is engraved on the Throne of Glory";
"And upon the likeness of the throne,
a likeness like the appearance of a man," etc.
And certainly one may not ascribe to Him, may He be blessed,
but rather, as it were, He, may He be blessed,
in all the details of their affairs,
which is in the form of a man.
that is, "like the appearance of a man";
and this is through the aspect of Yaakov,

inlineHeadings.text: Holiness That Endures Through Every Change
Every Soul Within the House of Yaakov

p: one is saved from the war of Gog and Magog
because of the desire for this world.
there will still be the war of Gog and Magog
are of the seed of Amalek,
the holiness of Yisrael in depth,
and especially against the attribute of Yosef HaTzaddik,
because they have not yet been fully refined
from every desire of this world,
including the aspect of the serpent's counsel,
which is the matter of self-awareness,
as we have already spoken of this.
For this reason our Sages, of blessed memory, said
שֶׁמֵּת בְּעֶטְיוֹ שֶׁל נָחָשׁ (בָּבָא בַּתְרָא יז, א)
that he died through the serpent's counsel (Bava Basra 17a):
because there was still found in him
a trace of sensing his own pleasure;
as our Sages, of blessed memory, said in the Midrash
even the most pious of the pious," etc.;
to bring me into being?" etc.
אָז יְבוּלַּע הַמָּוֶת לָנֶצַח (יְשַׁעְיָה כה, ח)
then "He will swallow up death forever" (Yeshayahu 25:8);
וְזֶה יִהְיֶה עַל יְדֵי מָשִׁיחַ בֶּן דָּוִד
and this will be through Mashiach ben David,
כְּמוֹ שֶׁאָמְרוּ זִכְרוֹנָם לִבְרָכָה (סוּכָּה נב, א)
as our Sages, of blessed memory, said (Sukkah 52a)
"Life he asked of You; You gave it to him":
that when he sees Mashiach ben Yosef slain
for he had not yet fully rectified
and it will be given to him.
by the Rebbe of Lublin, may the memory of the tzaddik be a blessing,
he wrote that Mashiach ben Yosef
that he wished to bring this about through his speech.
מֵהַמַּגִּיד מֵישָׁרִים דְּקָאזִינִיץ זֵכֶר צַדִּיק לִבְרָכָה
by the Maggid of Kozhnitz, may the memory of the tzaddik be a blessing,
he wrote that the war of Gog and Magog too
what he came to bring about,
and the Holy One, blessed be He, fulfills."
שֶׁהוּא נֶגֶד קְדוּשַּׁת יַעֲקֹב אָבִינוּ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם
which corresponds to the holiness of Yaakov Avinu, peace be upon him,
who holds onto the Tree of Life,
as our Rabbis, of blessed memory, said
שֶׁיַּעֲקֹב אָבִינוּ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם לֹא מֵת
that Yaakov Avinu, peace be upon him, did not die
one is saved from the wars of Gog and Magog,
which is the claim of deficiency
For this is the meaning of "did not die":
and he holds onto the Tree of Life,
of which "those who taste it merit life,"
